rows.speaker: Tsukikage
rows.en: So, in the end, this is all the strength that managed to reach Antarctica.
rows.display_text:
「So, in the end, this is all the strength
that managed to reach Antarctica.」

rows.speaker: Quinstein
rows.en: The other unit members have taken on the surrounding defense force. Destroy the artificial sun while you still can.
rows.display_text:
「The other units have taken on the
surrounding defense force. Destroy the
artificial sun while you still can.」

rows.speaker: Quinstein
rows.en: By my calculations, in five more minutes the artificial sun will be fully operational and start melting Antarctica's ice.
rows.display_text:
「By my calculations, in five more minutes
the artificial sun will be operational and
start melting Antarctica's ice.」

rows.speaker: Tsukikage
rows.en: The next five minutes decide the Earth's future! Everyone, pour every bit of firepower you have into the artificial sun!
rows.display_text:
「Five minutes decide Earth's fate!
Everyone, unload everything on the
artificial sun!」

rows.speaker: Jamie
rows.en: Artificial sun confirmed shot down! The ice melt in the area has stopped too!
rows.display_text:
「Artificial sun confirmed shot down! The
ice melt in the area has stopped too!」

rows.speaker: Tsukikage
rows.en: Well done, everyone. The operation's a success.
rows.display_text:
「Well done, everyone. The operation's a
success.」

rows.speaker: Quinstein
rows.en: Thank you, Marin. It was your strength that saved tomorrow.
rows.display_text:
（Thank you, Marin. It was your strength
that saved tomorrow.）

rows.speaker: Jamie
rows.en: Th-this way, the Earth will... flood...

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: No good, Marin... What exactly are you doing...
rows.display_text:
「No good, Marin... What exactly are you
doing...」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: You're supposed to be saving the Earth, aren't you... That blue sky and sea... and the land...
rows.display_text:
「You're supposed to be saving the Earth,
aren't you... That blue sky and sea... and
the land...」

rows.speaker: Quinstein
rows.en: That's right. That devil's weapon has been deployed to Antarctica once again.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. That devil's weapon has
been deployed to Antarctica once again.」

rows.speaker: Tsukikage
rows.en: The Alien Alliance has formed a defense line across the surrounding area.
rows.display_text:
「The Alien Alliance has formed a defense
line across the surrounding area.」

rows.speaker: Tsukikage
rows.en: Breaking through that defense line is going to cost us a considerable amount of our forces.
rows.display_text:
「Breaking through that defense line is
going to cost us a considerable amount of
our forces.」

rows.speaker: Quinstein
rows.en: By my calculations, even sending our entire force to Antarctica, the most we could commit to destroying the artificial sun is one warship and six squads.
rows.display_text:
「By my math, all-out to Antarctica nets
one warship, six squads max against the
artificial sun.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: Even so, there's nothing to do but go through with it... I can't let the Earth become another Planet S-1...!
rows.display_text:
「Even so, there's nothing to do but go
through with it... I can't let the Earth
become another Planet S-1...!」
